the design, fabrication and performance evaluation of two-color MW and LW HgCdTe IR detectors and FPAs.
the development of advanced HgCdTe detector technologies for the fabrication of two-color infrared detectors and FPAs.
the fabrication of advanced infrared detectors and focal plane arrays (FPA) for the next generation of infrared imaging systems.
